attributes.title: 2027 NASW DMV Joint Annual Conference
attributes.series: NASW DMV Joint Annual Conference (DC, Maryland and Virginia)
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Metro DC Chapter
attributes.summary:
For 2027 the Metro DC, Maryland and Virginia chapters of the National Association of Social Workers combine their annual meetings into one DMV Joint Annual Conference, held March 10 to 13, 2027, at the Kalahari Resort in Spotsylvania County, Virginia (mailing address Woodford, VA). The conference is fully hybrid: all presenters speak in person, and sessions are recorded for registrants who buy a package with on-demand viewing.

The chapters describe a typical audience of about 400 professional social workers, researchers and students, about three-quarters of them with ten or more years in the field. Sessions run 1.5 or 2 hours, and the call for proposals asked for advanced-level content on trauma, telehealth, ethics, race and social work, addiction, grief, technology, private practice and child and youth issues.

The call for proposals closed on October 21, 2026. Registration packages, fees and the total number of CE hours had not been posted when we checked. Presenters may earn up to 7 Category 2 CE hours for preparing and presenting a session; attendees should confirm the 2027 CE total and approvals for their license on the chapter pages once registration opens.
